notes.title: Added new story content
notes.content:
We have released an update for Uwagakiai.
The update includes the following changes:

Added new story content
Added new text to the EXTRA section (available after completing the new story content)
Modified certain text and effects in the main story

notes.title: Notice of Startup Failure
notes.content:
The update uploaded the wrong file, and some players are experiencing the following screen after the update and are unable to play the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43631390/cbc11487b00b4be436ff04391e1c88097a6656e4.jpg[/img]
We apologize for the inconvenience, but if this has happened to you, please take the following actions to be able to play the game.

[olist]
[*][h3]If you want to take over your save data[/h3]
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43631390/a1b9dd7b3742a77cf8a8f058d13b6956af6b58e2.jpg[/img]
From the library, right-click on "ウワガキアイ" and open the file from Browse local files.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43631390/339d41b848efe66566d2e400b9a3ad53c9fd8088.jpg[/img]
Once the uwagakiai folder appears, locate the save folder and copy it to another location for backup. (The contents may differ from the image)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43631390/d1d81b954a3f075ac967c3b6c3c00660c397bd56.jpg[/img]
From the library, right-click "ウワガキアイ" and select Uninstall.

Install uwagakiai again, open the file from Browse local files, put the save file you backed up in the uwagakiai folder and start it.

[olist]
[*][h3]If you have no problem resetting the save data[/h3]
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43631390/d1d81b954a3f075ac967c3b6c3c00660c397bd56.jpg[/img]
From the library, right-click "ウワガキアイ" and select Uninstall.

Install Uwagaki-e again and start it up.

[b]*Please note that you will not be able to restore your save if you uninstall without transferring the save data[/b].

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause you. We are planning to update the English translation and small in-game updates in the future, and we will work hard to deliver a game that will meet your expectations.
